name: agent
title: Agent
description: Procedural 3D mascot for React Three Fiber. Seven role presets, mixable outfit pieces, twelve typed actions, held props and reduced motion.

files.content:
export const agentRoles = [
  "orchestrator",
  "architect",
  "researcher",
  "builder",
  "debugger",
  "inspector",
  "analyst",
] as const;

export type AgentRole = (typeof agentRoles)[number];

export const agentActions = [
  "idle",
  "wave",
  "walk",
  "type",
  "inspect",
  "point",
  "read",
  "carry",
  "direct",
  "celebrate",
  "measure",
  "check",
] as const;

export type AgentAction = (typeof agentActions)[number];

export const agentReactions = [
  "wave",
  "jump",
  "spin",
  "look",
  "salute",
  "shuffle",
  "surprised",
  "peek",
] as const;

export type AgentReaction = (typeof agentReactions)[number];

export const agentRoleLabels = {
  analyst: "Analyst agent",
  architect: "Architect agent",
  builder: "Builder agent",
  debugger: "Debugger agent",
  inspector: "Inspector agent",
  orchestrator: "Orchestrator agent",
  researcher: "Researcher agent",
} as const satisfies Record<AgentRole, string>;

export const agentSignatureActions = {
  analyst: "point",
  architect: "measure",
  builder: "type",
  debugger: "inspect",
  inspector: "check",
  orchestrator: "direct",
  researcher: "read",
} as const satisfies Record<AgentRole, AgentAction>;

props.description: A group of meshes. Render it inside a React Three Fiber Canvas with lights. It stands on y = 0 and is about 2.4 units tall with its headgear.

props.name: role
props.description: Which preset outfit the mascot wears, from rolePresets in outfit.ts. The rig, clips and materials are shared.

props.name: outfit
props.description: Mix pieces across roles: { head, face, torso, held, offhand }, each a piece id from outfitPieceIds or "none". Overrides the role preset. Held props keep their per-action poses.

props.name: animateOutfit
props.description: When the outfit changes, the agent hops with a small squash and each new piece drops into place. Off under reduced motion.

props.name: action
props.description: Clip to play. Changing it crossfades over 0.38 seconds.

props.name: actionRef
props.description: Drives the action from a ref that is read every frame, so switching never re-renders. Wins over action.

props.name: motion
props.description: reduced holds each clip's key pose with no blink, breathing or loops.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Blob contact shadow under the feet. No shadow maps are used.

props.name: position
props.description: Placement. Every React Three Fiber group prop except children is accepted, including rotation, scale and pointer handlers.

Typed outfit in outfit.ts: one piece id per slot. Each piece in accessories/registry.ts is an AccessoryKit that attaches meshes to anchors (head, face, torso, body, rightArm, leftArm), so a coat can bring its sleeves. The mapped types fail the build until every piece id has meshes.

props.name: head
props.description: Hats and helmets on top of the body.

props.name: face
props.description: Glasses and shades on the eye line.

props.name: torso
props.description: Coats and vests. Coats and the sweater add sleeves to both arms.

props.name: held
props.description: Main prop: in the right hand, or in front of the body for the laptop and book.

props.name: offhand
props.description: Prop in the mirrored left hand.

variants.name: role
variants.description: Selects the preset outfit: headgear, coat, glasses and the props in each hand. Pass outfit to mix pieces.

variants.name: action
variants.description: Selects the clip. Held props re-aim with it, so the builder stows the laptop while carrying and walking.

variants.name: motion
variants.description: full plays the clips. reduced holds the key pose.

examples.title: Agent in your own Canvas
examples.description: Any React Three Fiber canvas works. The agent stands on y = 0, so lower it to centre it under the camera.

examples.title: Switch actions without re-rendering
examples.description: Write to actionRef from event handlers. The rig reads it every frame and crossfades.

examples.title: Mix an outfit
examples.description: Spread a role preset and swap single pieces. animateOutfit hops the agent and drops each new piece in.

accessibility: The mascot is decorative. Wrap the Canvas in an element with role=img and a label, or mark it aria-hidden.
Put anything the agent communicates in text next to the canvas.
motion=reduced, or the prefers-reduced-motion query when motion is omitted, holds each action's key pose. No blink, breathing, bobbing or loops.
The agent adds no focusable elements and never captures focus. Pointer handlers pass through to the group.

animation.properties: Arm, leg, body and eye transforms
animation.timing: One useFrame per agent. 0.38 second smoothstep crossfade between clips.
0.13 seconds every 3.4 to 5.6 seconds, offset per agent.

animation.properties: Agent hop and squash, new piece position and scale
animation.timing: 0.34 second hop. Each new piece falls 0.5 units over 0.46 seconds with an ease-out-back overshoot.
animation.trigger: outfit changes while animateOutfit is set
animation.reducedMotion: Pieces swap in place with no hop.

docs: Requires React 19. Render <Agent role="builder" /> inside a React Three Fiber <Canvas> with lights, or add agent-stage for a ready scene.
